ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Set this Text environment variable in Worker Settings → Variables and Secrets. Use comma-separated image source hosts, e.g. cdn.example.com, *.images.example.com; include images.unsplash.com for the demo. Dashboard values are preserved across code deployments.

DERIVATIVES.description: Private cache of generated WebP images. Original images are not stored.
